name: pulseflow
description: Production-minded payment, webhook, queue and notification orchestration portfolio project.

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @pulseflow/api && npm run build -w @pulseflow/worker && npm run build -w @pulseflow/web
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -ws --if-present
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:shared && npm run test:integration -w @pulseflow/api
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build:shared && npm run test:coverage -ws --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -ws --if-present
scripts.quality: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run validate:repo
scripts.prisma:seed: npm run build:shared && npm run prisma:seed -w @pulseflow/database
scripts.build:shared: npm run prisma:generate && npm run build -w @pulseflow/contracts && npm run build -w @pulseflow/database
